text.p: Tropical storm warnings are up for the Isle of Youth and the Pinar Del Rio province of West Cuba. Tropical Storm Marco, with 50 mph winds, is centered 105 miles south southeast of Cabo San Antonio on the West tip of Cuba, moving northwest at 13 mph. Marco will weaken today and slow in forward speed. Heavy rain over the warned area may result in flooding.
Tropical Cyclone Cyril will dissipate near New Caledonia during the next 24 hours but may produce heavy rain squalls and local flash floods over the island.

Tropical Cyclone Chantelle, with 65 mph winds, is in the South Indian Ocean near 9.5s/81.0e, moving west southwest at 15 mph. This system will continue to intensify and move west southwest over open water, threatening shipping.

Tropical Depression 40W will be fairly weak in the Philippine Sea, only a moderate threat to shipping. This system is near 19.4n/140.5e, moving northwest at 10 mph. Top winds, now 30 mph, may increase slightly this period.
